CHAPTER.VERS: Fools say in their heart,“There is no God.”Vile, hateful their life is;not one does good.
From heaven the looks outon humans, to seeif any are wise,and care for God.
But all have turned bad,the taint is on all;not one does good,no, not one.
Have they learned their lesson,those workers of evil?Who ate up my people,eating, devouring,never calling to the .
Sore afraid will they be;for God is amongthose who are righteous,
you may mock the plans of the poor,but the is their refuge.
If only help from Zionwould come for Israel!When the brings his peoplea change of fortune,how glad will be Jacob,and Israel how joyful!
